meta.title: SprintView: Dependencies blank for Sprint 2 & 3 due to schema field mismatch

content.tldr: SprintView was only reading content.dependencies to populate the 'Dependencies' section. Sprint 2 and Sprint 3 JSON files use content.prerequisites instead, causing that section to render blank for those sprints.
content.environment: wiki-app (Next.js) — sprint detail view for any sprint using 'prerequisites' key
steps_to_reproduce: Open the wiki-app in a browser.
Observe that the 'Dependencies' section is absent / empty.
Inspect wiki/plan/sprints/sprint-2.json and confirm the field is 'prerequisites', not 'dependencies'.
content.expected_behavior: The 'Dependencies' section should list all prerequisite/dependency items for every sprint, regardless of which field name the JSON file uses.
content.actual_behavior: The 'Dependencies' section was hidden for Sprint 2 and Sprint 3 because SprintView only read content.dependencies; sprint-2.json and sprint-3.json use content.prerequisites.
content.root_cause: Schema inconsistency: sprint-1.json uses 'dependencies' while sprint-2.json and sprint-3.json use 'prerequisites'. SprintView only merged the former, so the latter was silently ignored.

audit.author: vibe-qa-general
audit.note: Bug identified: SprintView only read content.dependencies; sprint-2 and sprint-3 use content.prerequisites.

audit.author: vibe-backend-general
audit.note: SprintView updated to spread both content.dependencies and content.prerequisites into a single array before rendering.
